service.en: Absence report for a domestic worker
service.ar: بلاغ تغيب عامل خدمة منزلية عن العمل
service.ur: گھریلو ملازم کی غیر حاضری کی رپورٹ

about: Let an employer report a domestic worker who has left and cannot be found.
note: Requirements read from the official MOHRE service page on the checked date. Field labels sit behind sign-in, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Worker has been absent more than seven days
Employer cannot find or contact the worker
documents: Worker's passport or employment visa, if available
fees: 315 AED outside Dubai; Dubai is handled by its residency directorate
Business centres may add a commission of up to 72 AED
